name: CLOUD BELL
overview: The Cloud Bell Series draws its vocabulary from the gentle curves of hanging bells and the soft fullness of clouds at dusk — organic forms that carry both visual weight and an inherent sense of movement. Each bell element is individually crafted from layered acrylic and crystal, achieving a depth of luminous translucency that flat surfaces cannot replicate. Deployed in clusters of varying heights, the Cloud Bell Series creates installations that feel more like kinetic sculpture than conventional lighting — ideal for clients who treat their spaces as galleries of lived experience.
